exposure: adherence to a standard of process indicators
Adherence to standard of process indicators
Extraneous variables (e.g., caesarean sections, vaginal deliveries, referral from other health care facilities)
referral from other health care facilities
outcome: Referral rate from other health care facilities
cohort: Women who experienced maternal death or near miss in an academic public tertiary hospital in Yogyakarta, Indonesia between February 1, 2011 and September 30, 2012
finding: Women experiencing maternal near misses received faster response times and better treatment compared to women who died during childbirth.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections were less frequent in maternal deaths compared to near misses, while vaginal deliveries were more frequent in maternal deaths.
